Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe incident you
reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.
A: I was driving in the right lane on a multi-lane road and needed to move over to make a turn coming up. I checked
my mirror, signaled, and started to shift into the left lane. Another vehicle was there and we made contact along the
side of my car. It was a scraping sort of impact, not a big crash.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?
A: I looked in the mirror and didn't see anything right beside me. I think it came up quickly from behind in the blind
spot after I'd already started moving.
Q: Where did the contact occur on your vehicle?
A: Along the passenger side, toward the rear door and back quarter panel.
Q: Did you stop at the scene, and did anyone exchange information?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. We swapped insurance and contact information and took some photos of
the damage.
Q: Were there any injuries?
A: I didn't think I was hurt right away, but by the next day my neck was stiff and sore. I've been dealing with a strain in
my neck and some tightness across my shoulders since then.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for that?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic and I'm following up with my regular doctor. They told me it looks like a neck strain.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide the photos and medical paperwork if you need them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
